blocks.title: Fossil fuels
blocks.text: Petroleum (crude oil yani kacha tel), coal (koyla) aur natural gas (qudrati gas) ko mila kar fossil fuels kehte hain.

Crude oil zameen ke neeche ke zakhiron (reservoirs) se nikala jata hai aur bare plants mein fractional distillation se refine (saaf) kiya jata hai. Petroleum se milne wali bari cheezein naphtha, gasoline, kerosene aur diesel hain.

Methane (CH₄) natural gas ka sab se bara hissa hai; is ke saath ethane, propane aur butane bhi mili hoti hain. Methane zyada tar ammonia (jo fertilizers yani khaad mein use hoti hai) aur methanol (jo solvents aur fuel mein use hota hai) banane mein kaam aati hai. Coal ab pehle jitna mufeed nahi raha, lekin jahan is ke zakhire zyada hain wahan ab bhi petrochemicals ka raw material (kacha maal) hai. Coal ka bara istemal benzene, toluene aur xylene hasil karna hai, jo dyes (rang), resins aur explosives (dhamaka khez cheezein) banane ke liye zaruri hain.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhein
blocks.text: Fossil fuels energy ke bohat achhe zariye hain, lekin in ke jalne (combustion) se carbon dioxide (CO₂) jaisi greenhouse gases banti hain. Is se hawa ki aaloodgi (air pollution), global warming aur climate change (mausam ki tabdeeli) hoti hai.

blocks.prompt: Benzene, toluene aur xylene kis fossil fuel se milte hain, aur kis kaam aate hain?
blocks.explanation: Coal se; yeh dyes, resins aur explosives banane mein use hote hain.

items: Fossil fuels: petroleum, coal, natural gas.
Natural gas (zyada tar CH₄): ammonia aur methanol; coal: benzene, toluene, xylene.
Jalne se CO₂: air pollution, global warming, climate change.
